description: This source file implements utility functions for GStreamer Media Source Extensions (MSE), specifically setting up supported capabilities (caps) for a GStreamer element based on supported MIME types. It defines a function that maps MIME types to GStreamer caps, avoids duplicate caps, and adds a pad template to a GStreamer element class.

methods.name: rialto_mse_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up supported capabilities (caps) for a GStreamer element class based on a list of MIME types, mapping them to GStreamer caps, avoiding duplicates, and adding a sink pad template.
